_comment: Copy this file to tokens/local.json to activate local overrides.
The build script deep-merges local.json ON TOP of base.json,
so you can override existing tokens or add entirely new ones.
New tokens get CSS variables, utility classes, and Tailwind
integration automatically — no build script changes needed.

brand._comment: Override the standard brand ramp for your product

accent._comment: New token branch — extends the system

spacing._comment: Add a 3xl tier that doesn't exist in base

duration._comment: Entirely new token category for transitions

z._comment: Z-index scale — useful for layering governance
